account_growth_snapshots_counts_check.name: account_growth_snapshots_counts_check
account_growth_snapshots_counts_check.value:
("account_growth_snapshots"."follower_count" is null or "account_growth_snapshots"."follower_count" >= 0)
        and ("account_growth_snapshots"."following_count" is null or "account_growth_snapshots"."following_count" >= 0)
        and ("account_growth_snapshots"."media_count" is null or "account_growth_snapshots"."media_count" >= 0)
        and ("account_growth_snapshots"."engagement_rate_bps" is null or "account_growth_snapshots"."engagement_rate_bps" >= 0)
        and "account_growth_snapshots"."posts_sampled" >= 0

account_growth_snapshots_follower_status.name: account_growth_snapshots_follower_status_check
account_growth_snapshots_follower_status.value:
("account_growth_snapshots"."status" = 'unavailable' and "account_growth_snapshots"."follower_count" is null)
        or ("account_growth_snapshots"."status" in ('complete', 'partial') and "account_growth_snapshots"."follower_count" is not null)

instagram_execution_controls_shape_check.name: instagram_execution_controls_shape_check
instagram_execution_controls_shape_check.value:
("instagram_execution_controls"."scope" = 'system' and "instagram_execution_controls"."user_id" is null and "instagram_execution_controls"."ig_account_id" is null and "instagram_execution_controls"."action" is null)
        or ("instagram_execution_controls"."scope" = 'action' and "instagram_execution_controls"."user_id" is null and "instagram_execution_controls"."ig_account_id" is null and "instagram_execution_controls"."action" is not null)
        or ("instagram_execution_controls"."scope" = 'tenant' and "instagram_execution_controls"."user_id" is not null and "instagram_execution_controls"."ig_account_id" is null and "instagram_execution_controls"."action" is null)
        or ("instagram_execution_controls"."scope" = 'account' and "instagram_execution_controls"."user_id" is not null and "instagram_execution_controls"."ig_account_id" is not null and "instagram_execution_controls"."action" is null)

weekly_report_deliveries_lease_check.name: weekly_report_deliveries_lease_check
weekly_report_deliveries_lease_check.value:
("weekly_report_deliveries"."status" = 'sending'
          and "weekly_report_deliveries"."lease_token" is not null
          and "weekly_report_deliveries"."lease_expires_at" is not null)
        or ("weekly_report_deliveries"."status" <> 'sending'
          and "weekly_report_deliveries"."lease_token" is null
          and "weekly_report_deliveries"."lease_expires_at" is null)
